review_type: source-grounded AI review; not physician adjudication
reviewed_components: all clinical facts and measured quantities
corrections: Merged narrative repeats into the table item for the same test, value and time (OBS-TABLE-ROWS/ONE-STATEMENT), whether or not the text cites the table: p1 NLR 8.78; p2 NLR 18.25 and anti-AChR negative; p3 NT-proBNP 1433 and NLR 10.6; p4 coagulation normal, anti-AChR/anti-MuSK negative, NLR 11.14; removed the p3 ambiguity that justified keeping them separate.

Case 4 troponin T: Table 4 cell "I694ng/L" reclassified from source_conflict to an ambiguous review_only print artefact; the narrative value 1,694 ng/L (which cites Table 4 and says Admitting labs) is now included with time Admitting.
Case 4 NT-proBNP: unit conflict kept as two review_only items (pg/L table, ug/L text); added value-only include item p4-f110 (1369, unit null) so only the conflicting attribute is quarantined.
Case 4 troponin I: table cell and narrative 14 ng/L merged into one item (flag normal from "came back normal"), time left null; ambiguity rewritten (no double count of one result).
Case 3 oesophageal tumor: removed frontal lobe as a metastatic site (source does not attribute the brain metastasis to either of the two primaries).
Case 3 MRI-negative peri-lesional oedema and new lesions set to verification_status refuted (ASSERT-ABSENT).

Case 3 oral prednisolone given its literal time "in the following week"; tacrolimus evidence widened to its full sentence with indication lack of response to steroids, infection concern noted; neck item renamed difficulty with neck control.
Removed non-indication values from indication fields (p1 MMF stop reason, p4 pyridostigmine stop reason, p2 "Adjuvant treatment").

Added missed items: p1 cardiology review and immune-oncology specialist advice; p2 neurology discussion; p3 swallowing assessment, rapid deterioration despite initial treatment, not stable for transport.

Timeline: added p2 events (PLEX considered day 8 not_occurred, FVC 20% by day 9, tocilizumab/tacrolimus/pyridostigmine by day 10, MMF added) and p4 events (pyridostigmine stopped by day 5, oral prednisolone by day 7, post-discharge course); added relations supported by stated days or literal order words (eventually, worsened, at this time/only agreed, earlier during the admission, after discharge); reworded p1 e02 so it no longer implies all findings were at admission.
Summaries no longer state "raised" troponins/CK/NT-proBNP where the source gives no qualifier (p1, p2, p3, p4).

Merge audit under the coordinator ruling (keep a table/text merge only when the article reports that test once for the patient): p2-f059 anti-AChR, p3-f062 NT-proBNP, p4-f051 coagulation and p4-f058 anti-AChR/anti-MuSK are each reported only once with no sign of repeat testing, so all four merges are kept and the single-measurement reasoning is recorded in each note; the NLR merges share a literal admission time and were not disputed.
Visual: FIG3 red arrow direction corrected (points left and slightly down, not up and left); figure-EHR and privacy drafts regenerated and reviewed labels carried over.
unresolved: Case series of four patients; cohort-level statements in the abstract, methods and Discussion (mean age, drug and cancer-type counts, cycle timing, "all patients received ICI therapy within four weeks of symptom onset", anti-AChR results in 3 of 4) are not copied to individuals unless a sentence names the case or all four patients explicitly.
The abstract gives a mean age of 68.9 years while the Discussion gives 69.8 years; this is a cohort-level inconsistency not attributed to any patient.

Case 1 narrative (citing Table 1) and Table 1 differ for creatine kinase (10866 vs 10389 U/L) and troponin T (498 vs 393 ng/L): paired source_conflict, review_only values; the qualitative "CK was elevated" stays scorable. Case 4 NT-proBNP unit differs (narrative ug/L vs Table 4 pg/L): both unit readings review_only, the agreed value 1369 kept as a value-only item. The Case 4 Table 4 troponin T cell printed "I694ng/L" is treated as a print ambiguity (review_only), with the narrative 1,694 ng/L kept.

Case 4 troponin I 14 ng/L appears in Table 4 (captioned admitting laboratory results) and in the narrative as resulting 4 days into the admission; recorded as one result with time null and an ambiguity.
Laboratory tables print units as given (e.g. creatinine, CRP and cortisol in mmol/L); no units were converted or corrected and no flags were derived from printed reference ranges.
Where the narrative repeats a table value for the same test and time (with or without citing the table), the two are one item citing both, per OBS-TABLE-ROWS and ONE-STATEMENT.
The Discussion statement that all four patients received inappropriately lower initial steroid doses is an authorial judgement and is kept as an ambiguity only.

Cases are not individually identified outside the case headings; unlabelled Discussion sentences (e.g. a hepatitis diagnosis, delayed MG-directed therapy) were assigned only where the sentence names the patient or case or the case text itself states the fact.
Figure captions are author statements; pixel review is in visual.json. Figure assets match their captions and the case text that calls them out.
No supplements or videos are listed for this article.

key_findings: Four men (p1-p4 in case order) with ICI-induced MMM overlap; p2 and p3 died, p1 and p4 recovered; roster count 4 literal from the abstract.
Case 1 CK (10866 text vs 10389 Table 1) and troponin T (498 vs 393) are same-test, same-time value conflicts (text cites Table 1); both sides review_only, CK "elevated" stays scorable.
Case 1 muscle biopsy, EMG and NCS "not considered during the admission" are literally not done: kept as not_performed with the source wording in notes.
Case 4 "full blood count within normal limits" vs table lymphocytes and neutrophils outside printed ranges kept as an ambiguity with no flags derived from ranges.

Discussion sentences used only where they name the case (case 1, patient 2, patient 3) or state all four patients; unnamed sentences (hepatitis patient, MGC >= 13 patients, NLR survivors) were not attributed.
residual_risks: Tables print creatinine, CRP and cortisol in mmol/L; kept as printed.
p4-f110 carries the agreed NT-proBNP value 1369 with unit null because the narrative (ug/L) and Table 4 (pg/L) units conflict.
Case 4 troponin I timing (admitting table vs resulted day 4) is unresolved by the source.
